title: Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai: Nagisa ni Usemono Arite Senjin wa Enzen to [X] Suru
title_english: We Never Learn: BOKUBEN - The Predecessor [X] with Elegance with the Missing Item on the Beach
title_japanese: ぼくたちは勉強ができない「渚に失せものありて先人は艶然と[X]する」
synopsis:
The episode adapts chapters 48 and 49, which follow Yuiga and Asumi going on a fake date, and Yuiga encountering his teacher Mafuyu Kirisu after she accidentally loses her swimsuit top.

(Source: MAL News)
